exclusions: Do not frame inconsistency or rest as moral failure.
Do not use coercive or domination language.
Do not promise identity, income, status, or productivity outcomes.
Do not give clinical advice or address dependence, medication, or disordered eating.
prompt_context: Take one mechanism of behaviour change at a time and show how it actually works in an ordinary life. Establish the concrete situation, name the friction honestly, and keep the suggested action proportionate to it. The listener decides whether it fits.
compatibility_rules: Use only with the Practical Motivation Formula.
Keep every episode to one mechanism and one concrete situation.
Frame progress as adjustable practice, never a test of worth.

tuples.episode_object: the morning after a night shift
tuples.time_place_scope: a flat at ten in the morning with the curtains still drawn
tuples.mechanism: an anchor with no matching hour to sit in
tuples.evidence_lens: ask on those days whether the routine was skipped because you did not want it or because the slot did not exist

tuples.episode_object: clothes laid out over the back of a chair
tuples.time_place_scope: a bedroom at bedtime, everything else already off
tuples.mechanism: one decision pre-made so a cold start needs none
tuples.evidence_lens: notice on the mornings the clothes were not laid out how far you got before hesitating

tuples.episode_object: the same train caught at the same minute every weekday
tuples.time_place_scope: a platform at seventeen minutes past eight
tuples.mechanism: an external timetable enforcing a rhythm you would not enforce yourself
tuples.evidence_lens: look at what your routine does on days you work from home and the train is not there

tuples.episode_object: a note listing everything that stops when one thing stops
tuples.time_place_scope: a page written after a fortnight of collapse
tuples.mechanism: dependency made visible so it can be defended deliberately
tuples.evidence_lens: write the list before you need it, then check it against the next bad fortnight

coverage_profiles.subject: a habit that decays under sleep debt

tuples.episode_object: an alarm snoozed four times
tuples.time_place_scope: a bedroom between half five and quarter past six
tuples.mechanism: a decision handed to the least capable version of you
tuples.evidence_lens: log the number of snoozes beside the hours slept and see how tightly the two move together

tuples.episode_object: a pre-dawn session cancelled by a late-arriving sleep
tuples.time_place_scope: a dark bedroom at twenty to six
tuples.mechanism: a fixed wake time meeting a variable bedtime
tuples.evidence_lens: record the time you fell asleep, not the time you went to bed, and compare the two records

tuples.episode_object: a sleep tracker screen showing five hours
tuples.time_place_scope: a phone glanced at before getting up
tuples.mechanism: a number that shapes the day's expectations before anything has happened
tuples.evidence_lens: cover the number for a week and see whether the sessions still change with the sleep

tuples.episode_object: a decision taken at four in the afternoon about six the next morning
tuples.time_place_scope: an office desk in the flattest hour of the working day
tuples.mechanism: tomorrow's plan set at the point of lowest energy
tuples.evidence_lens: note the hour when each cancellation was decided and look for the cluster

tuples.episode_object: a second late night inside one working week
tuples.time_place_scope: a living room sofa past midnight on a Wednesday
tuples.mechanism: debt accumulating faster than a single weekend can settle it
tuples.evidence_lens: add up the shortfall against your usual night across the week rather than judging one night

tuples.episode_object: a child waking twice before three in the morning
tuples.time_place_scope: a landing between two bedrooms, lights off
tuples.mechanism: broken sleep that costs more than short sleep at the same total
tuples.evidence_lens: record the number of wakings, not only the hours, and see which one predicts the next day better

tuples.episode_object: a session that was completed but at half the usual load
tuples.time_place_scope: a gym floor on the Thursday of a broken week
tuples.mechanism: the habit surviving while its content quietly empties out
tuples.evidence_lens: track load and duration separately; attendance alone will hide this

tuples.episode_object: a second coffee poured before ten
tuples.time_place_scope: a work kitchen mid-morning
tuples.mechanism: an early stimulant top-up that pushes the following night later still
tuples.evidence_lens: note the time of your last caffeine and set it against the time you fell asleep

tuples.episode_object: a rota with two night shifts in it
tuples.time_place_scope: a printed staff schedule on a break room wall
tuples.mechanism: a routine planned in daylight hours by someone who will not have any
tuples.evidence_lens: plan the shift week separately and check afterwards whether the separate plan survived better

tuples.episode_object: a phone screen glowing at half past midnight
tuples.time_place_scope: under a duvet, room otherwise dark
tuples.mechanism: the last hour of the day borrowed from the first hour of the next
tuples.evidence_lens: look at screen-time records for the hour before sleep and lay them beside the mornings that followed

tuples.episode_object: a training log with the word 'flat' in three consecutive entries
tuples.time_place_scope: a notebook reviewed on a Sunday
tuples.mechanism: a subjective marker repeating before any objective one moves
tuples.evidence_lens: read your own adjectives across a month; the repeated word is the early signal

tuples.episode_object: an argument about whose turn it is to get up
tuples.time_place_scope: a kitchen at seven in the morning, both people tired
tuples.mechanism: shared recovery treated as an individual problem
tuples.evidence_lens: write down who got the earlier alarm each day for two weeks and look at the balance

tuples.episode_object: a clock radio showing the same hour every night
tuples.time_place_scope: a bedside table at ten to three
tuples.mechanism: a fixed waking point that no amount of effort in the day shifts
tuples.evidence_lens: note the time you wake in the night for a fortnight and see whether it is random or fixed

tuples.episode_object: a weekend lie-in that repays nothing
tuples.time_place_scope: a Saturday morning that runs to half eleven
tuples.mechanism: a repayment schedule the body does not honour in one instalment
tuples.evidence_lens: rate the Monday after a long lie-in and the Monday after an ordinary weekend

tuples.episode_object: a commute where the right stop went past
tuples.time_place_scope: a bus at half eight in the morning
tuples.mechanism: attention thinning in the small tasks before it shows in the big ones
tuples.evidence_lens: keep a note of small slips like this; they arrive before the missed sessions do

tuples.episode_object: a plan made for tomorrow at the point of greatest tiredness
tuples.time_place_scope: a sofa at half eleven at night, laptop still open
tuples.mechanism: planning done in a state that cannot represent tomorrow honestly
tuples.evidence_lens: move the planning to a rested hour for two weeks and see whether the plans hold better

tuples.episode_object: a session moved to lunchtime and actually finished
tuples.time_place_scope: a park bench forty minutes from a desk
tuples.mechanism: the routine relocated to the hour that survives a poor night
tuples.evidence_lens: record completion rates by hour of day across a month of imperfect sleep

tuples.episode_object: a room that never gets properly dark
tuples.time_place_scope: a bedroom facing a street lamp, curtains too thin
tuples.mechanism: an environmental leak that no amount of discipline compensates for
tuples.evidence_lens: stand in the room with the lights off for two minutes and see what you can still read

tuples.episode_object: an early flight and the three days that came after it
tuples.time_place_scope: an airport at twenty past four in the morning
tuples.mechanism: a single displaced night spreading its cost across a working week
tuples.evidence_lens: mark the travel day and then rate the next three days rather than only the day itself

tuples.episode_object: a bedtime that has drifted twenty minutes a week
tuples.time_place_scope: a household over the course of an autumn
tuples.mechanism: slow displacement too gradual to notice on any single night
tuples.evidence_lens: plot your bedtime for eight weeks on one line and look at the slope, not the points

coverage_profiles.subject: seasonal collapse of an outdoor routine

tuples.episode_object: the evening the clocks go back
tuples.time_place_scope: a street at five in the afternoon on the last Sunday of October
tuples.mechanism: an hour of usable light removed overnight rather than gradually
tuples.evidence_lens: look at your attendance in the fortnight either side of that Sunday

tuples.episode_object: a head torch with flat batteries
tuples.time_place_scope: a cupboard under the stairs on a November evening
tuples.mechanism: a kit failure that only matters for four months of the year
tuples.evidence_lens: switch it on in September, not on the first dark night you need it

tuples.episode_object: a bike still wearing summer tyres
tuples.time_place_scope: a wet road with fallen leaves on a Tuesday commute
tuples.mechanism: equipment matched to a season that has already ended
tuples.evidence_lens: run a thumb across the tread and ask what surface it was chosen for

tuples.episode_object: the last outdoor session of October
tuples.time_place_scope: a playing field at half six, floodlights not yet on
tuples.mechanism: an ending that happens without ever being announced
tuples.evidence_lens: find the date of your final outdoor session last year and see whether you noticed it at the time

tuples.episode_object: a park gate locked at four in the afternoon
tuples.time_place_scope: an iron gate with a winter opening notice taped to it
tuples.mechanism: an external timetable shrinking beneath your personal one
tuples.evidence_lens: read the winter opening hours in September and check them against your usual slot

tuples.episode_object: a pair of gloves that were never bought
tuples.time_place_scope: a cold handlebar on the first proper frost
tuples.mechanism: one missing item deciding whether the session happens at all
tuples.evidence_lens: list what stopped you on each abandoned day and see how many were single small items

tuples.episode_object: frost on a saddle
tuples.time_place_scope: a garden shed doorway at seven on a clear morning
tuples.mechanism: a delay at the start long enough to lose the decision
tuples.evidence_lens: time how long the bike takes to be usable on a frozen morning against a mild one

tuples.episode_object: standing water sitting in lane one of an athletics track
tuples.time_place_scope: a municipal track after three days of rain
tuples.mechanism: a surface becoming unusable while remaining technically open
tuples.evidence_lens: note the days you arrived and turned around, and what you did with that hour instead

tuples.episode_object: a route that passes under three broken streetlights
tuples.time_place_scope: a canal path between six and seven on a winter evening
tuples.mechanism: a summer route with a hidden winter condition attached
tuples.evidence_lens: walk the route once in the dark in daylight-saving week and mark where you feel unwilling

tuples.episode_object: open water at eleven degrees
tuples.time_place_scope: a lake edge on a Saturday morning in late September
tuples.mechanism: a gradual change that crosses a threshold on one particular day
tuples.evidence_lens: keep a note of the water temperature and the minutes you stayed in, week by week

tuples.episode_object: a tennis net taken down for winter
tuples.time_place_scope: a club court on the first weekend of November
tuples.mechanism: a shared facility withdrawing the routine rather than the person quitting it
tuples.evidence_lens: ask what happens to your court time and whether an indoor slot was ever priced

tuples.episode_object: a bike hung on a garage wall behind stacked boxes
tuples.time_place_scope: a cold garage in the week before Christmas
tuples.mechanism: storage that quietly raises the cost of restarting
tuples.evidence_lens: time how long it takes to get the bike out and rideable from where it stands now

tuples.episode_object: an indoor trainer bought in December and used twice
tuples.time_place_scope: a spare room with the door mostly shut
tuples.mechanism: a substitute that replaces the equipment but not the reasons
tuples.evidence_lens: ask what you actually liked about being outdoors, then check whether the substitute delivers any of it

tuples.episode_object: the first March evening still light at six
tuples.time_place_scope: a pavement outside a workplace at going-home time
tuples.mechanism: a returning cue arriving before the fitness that used to meet it
tuples.evidence_lens: on that first light evening, do a short honest session and note where you actually are

tuples.episode_object: a plan written in July for a week in January
tuples.time_place_scope: a garden table in high summer with the year mapped out
tuples.mechanism: a schedule drawn up under conditions it will never be executed in
tuples.evidence_lens: reread the summer plan in December and mark which lines assume daylight or warmth

tuples.episode_object: a jacket that is not quite warm enough
tuples.time_place_scope: an exposed stretch of coast path in a headwind
tuples.mechanism: a marginal kit choice turning an enjoyable hour into an endured one
tuples.evidence_lens: rate how you felt at the halfway point on three cold sessions and see whether it is the same complaint each time

tuples.episode_object: a group meeting point that has moved indoors
tuples.time_place_scope: a sports hall instead of a car park, first week of December
tuples.mechanism: the social anchor relocating while the individual habit stays outside
tuples.evidence_lens: find out where the group actually goes in winter before the winter begins

tuples.episode_object: a fortnight of ice on the pavements
tuples.time_place_scope: a residential street in the middle of a cold snap
tuples.mechanism: a genuine safety stop that outlasts the ice by several weeks
tuples.evidence_lens: mark the day the pavements cleared and the day you actually went back out

tuples.episode_object: a spring rebuild starting lower than last spring did
tuples.time_place_scope: an April park loop after a winter mostly indoors
tuples.mechanism: an annual reset that loses a little more ground with each cycle
tuples.evidence_lens: hold this April's first session against last April's and the one before

tuples.episode_object: a photograph from July used as a phone background in January
tuples.time_place_scope: a lock screen glanced at on a wet commute
tuples.mechanism: a remembered season standing in for a present one
tuples.evidence_lens: notice whether looking at it makes you go out or makes you wait for June

coverage_profiles.subject: the maintenance phase after the goal is met

tuples.episode_object: a medal hanging off the corner of a bookshelf
tuples.time_place_scope: a spare room three weeks after the event
tuples.mechanism: a finished target leaving no instruction for the following week
tuples.evidence_lens: look at what is written in your calendar for the seven days after the goal date

tuples.episode_object: a training plan whose final week is blank
tuples.time_place_scope: the last page of a printed twelve-week schedule
tuples.mechanism: a structure that ends precisely where the difficulty begins
tuples.evidence_lens: check whether any plan you have ever used said what to do the week after it finished

tuples.episode_object: an event entry not made for the following year
tuples.time_place_scope: an inbox in the week registration opens
tuples.mechanism: the absence of a next date removing the reason for today's session
tuples.evidence_lens: notice how your training changes in the fortnight after you decide not to enter

tuples.episode_object: a wardrobe of clothes that finally fit
tuples.time_place_scope: a bedroom on an ordinary Tuesday morning
tuples.mechanism: a daily result that has stopped being noticed because it is now normal
tuples.evidence_lens: recall the last time you registered the change; if you cannot, the feedback has gone silent

tuples.episode_object: the first Monday after the event
tuples.time_place_scope: a flat at half six with no alarm set
tuples.mechanism: a vacated slot that nothing has been assigned to
tuples.evidence_lens: watch what fills the hour that the routine used to occupy

tuples.episode_object: a club membership renewal notice
tuples.time_place_scope: an email opened at a desk on a lunch break
tuples.mechanism: a recurring cost forcing an explicit decision that was never made consciously
tuples.evidence_lens: before renewing, write one sentence saying what the next twelve months are for

tuples.episode_object: a coach's last message before the arrangement ends
tuples.time_place_scope: a phone screen on the evening after the final session
tuples.mechanism: external structure withdrawn at the exact point the internal kind is untested
tuples.evidence_lens: look at the first four weeks after any coaching ended and see what happened to the schedule

tuples.episode_object: a deliberately lower ceiling written into a new plan
tuples.time_place_scope: a kitchen table on a Sunday with a fresh sheet of paper
tuples.mechanism: a level chosen for holding rather than for climbing
tuples.evidence_lens: ask whether the plan you wrote could be repeated for two years without breaking anything

tuples.episode_object: a maintenance number that nobody congratulates you for
tuples.time_place_scope: a group chat where other people are posting new bests
tuples.mechanism: the loss of social reward when the metric stops moving
tuples.evidence_lens: notice which of your results get a response from others and which get none

tuples.episode_object: a six-week gap sitting in a five-year record
tuples.time_place_scope: a long log scrolled back through on a winter evening
tuples.mechanism: a pause that only becomes visible from a distance
tuples.evidence_lens: scroll your whole history and find the gaps; note what preceded each one

tuples.episode_object: a sentence describing the difference between a project and a practice
tuples.time_place_scope: the first page of a new notebook after the old one closed
tuples.mechanism: a change of category that has to be made deliberately or not at all
tuples.evidence_lens: say out loud whether this is still a project; if it is, name its end date

tuples.episode_object: a photograph taken at the finish line
tuples.time_place_scope: a phone gallery opened months later while looking for something else
tuples.mechanism: a peak image that makes every ordinary session look like a decline
tuples.evidence_lens: put an ordinary session from this month beside that photograph and describe both honestly

tuples.episode_object: an old plan reused because no new one was written
tuples.time_place_scope: a printer tray on the first Monday of a new block
tuples.mechanism: repetition of a build phase by a body that no longer needs building
tuples.evidence_lens: read the old plan and mark which weeks were designed to make you tired on purpose

tuples.episode_object: the point where progress stops being visible week to week
tuples.time_place_scope: a graph on a screen that has gone flat since spring
tuples.mechanism: feedback intervals lengthening past the point where they motivate
tuples.evidence_lens: change the window from weekly to yearly and look at the same data again

tuples.episode_object: a friend's question about what is next
tuples.time_place_scope: a pub table a fortnight after the finish
tuples.mechanism: social expectation of escalation applied to a phase that needs none
tuples.evidence_lens: prepare one honest answer to that question and notice how it feels to say it

tuples.episode_object: a smaller quieter goal written in pencil
tuples.time_place_scope: the margin of a diary page in the off season
tuples.mechanism: a low-stakes aim kept deliberately erasable
tuples.evidence_lens: check in a month whether the pencilled aim is still there and whether it was needed

tuples.episode_object: a bike odometer that has stopped climbing
tuples.time_place_scope: a handlebar display glanced at at a set of lights
tuples.mechanism: a cumulative counter that rewards volume and says nothing about holding
tuples.evidence_lens: look for any number you track that could reward consistency rather than growth

tuples.episode_object: a season with no event in it at all
tuples.time_place_scope: a calendar year viewed on one page in January
tuples.mechanism: an unstructured stretch that has to be designed rather than endured
tuples.evidence_lens: write what the empty season is for before it starts, then read it back in June

tuples.episode_object: a routine kept for no external reason
tuples.time_place_scope: a Wednesday morning in the third year of doing it
tuples.mechanism: an activity that has become part of the week rather than a means to something
tuples.evidence_lens: ask what you would lose if you stopped, and see whether the answer mentions any result

tuples.episode_object: a checklist of what maintaining actually requires
tuples.time_place_scope: a fridge door in the first month after the goal
tuples.mechanism: an explicit floor replacing the plan that used to do the deciding
tuples.evidence_lens: write the floor down and then check at month end how many weeks cleared it

coverage_profiles.subject: effort rising as the finish comes into view

tuples.episode_object: the last hundred metres of a long run
tuples.time_place_scope: a stretch of pavement where the front door becomes visible
tuples.mechanism: pace lifting the moment the end becomes perceptible
tuples.evidence_lens: look at your final segment split against the four before it

tuples.episode_object: a progress bar sitting at ninety per cent
tuples.time_place_scope: a laptop screen late in a long evening of work
tuples.mechanism: a visible remainder small enough to feel finishable
tuples.evidence_lens: note the times you carried on past your intended stop and what was on screen when you did

tuples.episode_object: a chapter list with two entries still unticked
tuples.time_place_scope: a revision desk in the last week before an exam
tuples.mechanism: a countable remainder converting a vague task into a short one
tuples.evidence_lens: compare how much you did in the weeks when the remainder was countable and when it was not

tuples.episode_object: the final week of a twelve-week block
tuples.time_place_scope: a training diary open at the last spread
tuples.mechanism: compliance peaking exactly where fatigue is highest
tuples.evidence_lens: work out your attendance rate by week and see which week scored best

tuples.episode_object: a loyalty card with two stamps left
tuples.time_place_scope: a counter in a shop on a walk home
tuples.mechanism: proximity to a reward pulling behaviour that distance did not
tuples.evidence_lens: note how often you visited during the first half of the card and during the second

tuples.episode_object: a sprint finish that leaves nothing for the next day
tuples.time_place_scope: a park path in the final two hundred metres
tuples.mechanism: reserves spent on the visible end at the cost of the invisible next session
tuples.evidence_lens: rate the following day after a hard finish and after an even one

tuples.episode_object: a deadline that pulls the whole task into two evenings
tuples.time_place_scope: a kitchen table on the Wednesday and Thursday before a Friday due date
tuples.mechanism: work compressing into the final window because that is where the pressure lives
tuples.evidence_lens: log the hours you spent per week across the project and look at the shape

tuples.episode_object: a project stalled at forty per cent
tuples.time_place_scope: a folder that has not been opened for three weeks
tuples.mechanism: a middle stretch with neither novelty nor a visible end
tuples.evidence_lens: identify where every abandoned project of yours stopped, as a rough fraction

tuples.episode_object: a finish line drawn artificially close
tuples.time_place_scope: a whiteboard where a year was cut into six-week pieces
tuples.mechanism: a long effort split so an end is always within sight
tuples.evidence_lens: try one short block with a real end date and see whether the last fortnight lifts

tuples.episode_object: a countdown written large on a wall
tuples.time_place_scope: a garage wall with a number rewritten each morning
tuples.mechanism: a shrinking figure supplying urgency the calendar does not
tuples.evidence_lens: watch whether your effort changes as the number crosses ten

tuples.episode_object: the last box of a house move
tuples.time_place_scope: an emptying hallway at nine at night
tuples.mechanism: the end of a job producing energy that its middle never did
tuples.evidence_lens: notice how the final hour of a long task compares with the third hour

tuples.episode_object: the final set of five
tuples.time_place_scope: a gym bench with the bar already loaded
tuples.mechanism: knowing the count changing what the last repetitions feel like
tuples.evidence_lens: try one session with the total hidden and describe the difference afterwards

tuples.episode_object: a savings target within touching distance
tuples.time_place_scope: a banking app opened on the last day of the month
tuples.mechanism: a near number producing restraint that a far number never produced
tuples.evidence_lens: look at your monthly figures and find where the tightening began

tuples.episode_object: an event that speeds up in its closing mile
tuples.time_place_scope: a road race in the final stretch before the finishing arch
tuples.mechanism: held reserve released when the remaining distance becomes certain
tuples.evidence_lens: ask what that surge proves about what was available earlier in the effort

tuples.episode_object: the working week before a holiday
tuples.time_place_scope: an office on the Thursday before two weeks off
tuples.mechanism: an approaching hard stop clearing a backlog nothing else cleared
tuples.evidence_lens: compare what got finished that week with an ordinary week the month before

tuples.episode_object: a book abandoned around page two hundred
tuples.time_place_scope: a bedside pile with a bookmark that has not moved
tuples.mechanism: a remainder still large enough to feel indefinite
tuples.evidence_lens: work out the pages left and give yourself a date; then see whether the pace changes

tuples.episode_object: a finish moved further away halfway through
tuples.time_place_scope: a meeting where a delivery date slipped by a month
tuples.mechanism: a receding end taking the pull with it
tuples.evidence_lens: note the effort in the fortnight before the date moved and the fortnight after

tuples.episode_object: a milestone invented at the midpoint
tuples.time_place_scope: a calendar edited in the sixth week of a long stretch
tuples.mechanism: an intermediate marker installed exactly where the pull is weakest
tuples.evidence_lens: put a marker in the middle of your next long effort and see whether the dip is shallower

tuples.episode_object: the last day of a thirty-day block
tuples.time_place_scope: a bedroom on the evening of day thirty
tuples.mechanism: an end date that concentrates effort and then removes the reason for it
tuples.evidence_lens: look at what happened on days thirty-one to thirty-five in any block you have finished

tuples.episode_object: a surge followed by a fortnight of nothing
tuples.time_place_scope: a log with a spike and then a long flat stretch
tuples.mechanism: a finishing burst borrowing from the weeks on the far side of the line
tuples.evidence_lens: read the two weeks after every peak in your record and see whether the pattern repeats

coverage_profiles.subject: a habit that only survives under supervision

tuples.episode_object: a class register with your name written on it
tuples.time_place_scope: a sports hall doorway at ten to seven
tuples.mechanism: attendance recorded by someone who will notice the blank
tuples.evidence_lens: compare your attendance at registered sessions with sessions where nobody takes names

tuples.episode_object: a coach standing at the end of the lane
tuples.time_place_scope: a pool at half six with three other swimmers
tuples.mechanism: immediate observation changing what the last repetitions look like
tuples.evidence_lens: record the same set with and without someone watching and compare the final effort

tuples.episode_object: a training partner's car outside at six
tuples.time_place_scope: a dark street with the engine idling
tuples.mechanism: another person's wasted journey acting as the real cost of not going
tuples.evidence_lens: notice whether it is the session or the other person's morning you are protecting

tuples.episode_object: a physiotherapy sheet only ever completed in the clinic
tuples.time_place_scope: a treatment room with a plinth and a wall mirror
tuples.mechanism: exercises tied to a place rather than to a time
tuples.evidence_lens: mark on the sheet where each session actually happened for a fortnight

tuples.episode_object: the first week after a course finishes
tuples.time_place_scope: a Thursday evening that used to belong to a class
tuples.mechanism: a scaffold removed all at once instead of in stages
tuples.evidence_lens: watch that specific evening for four weeks and record what filled it

tuples.episode_object: a gym contract quietly lapsing
tuples.time_place_scope: a bank statement scanned on a Sunday
tuples.mechanism: a financial commitment that was doing the work the intention was not
tuples.evidence_lens: check the last date you attended against the last date you paid

tuples.episode_object: a shared spreadsheet that one other person reads
tuples.time_place_scope: a browser tab left open at a work desk
tuples.mechanism: a low-cost visible record with a named reader
tuples.evidence_lens: ask whether you have ever left a row blank, and what you did instead

tuples.episode_object: a video call left open while two people work in silence
tuples.time_place_scope: two rooms in different cities, both at nine in the morning
tuples.mechanism: presence without instruction supplying most of the effect
tuples.evidence_lens: log your finished tasks on called mornings against solo ones for two weeks

tuples.episode_object: a deposit returned on attendance
tuples.time_place_scope: a booking confirmation with a cancellation clause
tuples.mechanism: a small forfeit attached to not turning up
tuples.evidence_lens: notice at what level the forfeit starts to change your decision, and what level does nothing

tuples.episode_object: a group chat that has gone quiet
tuples.time_place_scope: a phone thread with no message for eleven days
tuples.mechanism: peer attention fading before individual attendance does
tuples.evidence_lens: look at when the messages stopped and when your own sessions thinned

tuples.episode_object: a booked slot as opposed to an intention
tuples.time_place_scope: a booking screen on a Sunday night for the week ahead
tuples.mechanism: a named time held by a system outside your own head
tuples.evidence_lens: keep a tally of booked sessions attended and unbooked sessions attended

tuples.episode_object: a coach away for three weeks
tuples.time_place_scope: an empty poolside in the middle of August
tuples.mechanism: a temporary absence exposing how much was borrowed structure
tuples.evidence_lens: record what you did in each of those three weeks without adjusting the account afterwards

tuples.episode_object: a studio mirror and a corrected shoulder position
tuples.time_place_scope: a class on a Wednesday evening, back row

tuples.episode_object: instructions that assumed you would remember why
tuples.time_place_scope: a note found a fortnight after it was written
tuples.mechanism: a reminder missing the reasoning that made it persuasive
tuples.evidence_lens: read an old note and see whether you can reconstruct the intent behind it

tuples.episode_object: a decision made once and written on a card
tuples.time_place_scope: a repeated situation that arises several times a week
tuples.mechanism: a standing rule replacing a fresh judgement each time
tuples.evidence_lens: how many times that rule saved you from deciding all over again

tuples.episode_object: a start time that leaves no margin
tuples.time_place_scope: an evening plan with no gap between arriving home and beginning
tuples.mechanism: a schedule with no slack for a bad day
tuples.evidence_lens: how many evenings the plan needed everything else to go right

tuples.episode_object: a note that scolds
tuples.time_place_scope: a kitchen surface read at the end of a hard week
tuples.mechanism: a self-instruction written in a tone that repels
tuples.evidence_lens: read your last few notes aloud and hear how they actually land

tuples.episode_object: a task broken down to its first physical action
tuples.time_place_scope: a desk at the point where a long job must resume
tuples.mechanism: an entry point small enough to require no resolve
tuples.evidence_lens: write only the first movement down, and see whether you performed it

tuples.episode_object: a bottle filled and left by the door
tuples.time_place_scope: a hallway table on the way out on an ordinary weekday
tuples.mechanism: preparation placed on an unavoidable path
tuples.evidence_lens: the days it left the house with you, and the days you walked straight past

tuples.episode_object: a limit set before the tiredness arrives
tuples.time_place_scope: a late evening when stopping would be the sensible move
tuples.mechanism: a boundary agreed in advance by a clearer version of you
tuples.evidence_lens: the times you stayed past the limit, and what you had decided earlier that day

tuples.episode_object: a version of the plan meant for a bad day
tuples.time_place_scope: a page kept beside the main plan and rarely read
tuples.mechanism: an explicit fallback removing the choice between all and nothing
tuples.evidence_lens: does the fallback exist in writing, or only as an intention

tuples.episode_object: a handover you once wrote for a colleague
tuples.time_place_scope: instructions left for a person covering your work
tuples.mechanism: clarity produced for an outsider that you never wrote for yourself
tuples.evidence_lens: read that handover again and see how much of it applies to you
